summary_zh: 今日泰國製造業焦點：Rockwell推出新款HMI，主打舊設備不停產升級並兼顧資安，反映設備升級與資安需求浮現；EA展示商用電動車量產就緒，汽車零件EV轉型持續；泰國因375家工廠違規，目標12月內閣審議電子廢棄物管制，環保稽查壓力升高。
summary_en: Thailand: Rockwell's new HMI targets no-downtime legacy upgrades with cyber security; EA shows commercial EV mass-production readiness as auto-parts EV shift continues; Thailand aims for December cabinet review of e-waste rules after 375 factories violated them.
